info.name: Wyzant Partner Data Data Feed Search API
Search active tutors in real time

params.name: PartnerAPIKey
params.description: Wyzant-issued partner API key (GUID) used for conversion tracking.

params.name: SearchString
params.description: Free-text search string, typically a subject (e.g. "Accounting", "Excel").

params.name: ZIP
params.description: US ZIP code to center a location-based search.

params.name: Distance
params.description: Search radius in miles around the ZIP code.

params.name: MinHourly
params.description: Minimum tutor hourly rate in USD.

params.name: MaxHourly
params.description: Maximum tutor hourly rate in USD.

params.name: MaxResults
params.description: Maximum number of tutors to return.

params.name: ChannelName
params.description: Partner-defined channel label for conversion tracking.

items.docs: Runs a real-time search against Wyzant's live tutor database and returns matching active tutors. Parameters are passed as form arguments. A valid partner API key (PartnerAPIKey) is required for conversion tracking.
